new_notices.description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable by signed-in users. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if signed-in users should not call it.
new_notices.detail: Function `public.rpc_get_notification_preferences(p_expected_user_id uuid, p_role text)` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/rpc_get_notification_preferences`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.
